answer: A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Cosignatures are collected in spiral, verified in ivory, and beacon names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 5 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 9 submissions per epoch. That is 994 dollars of sunk cost for a share worth less than the deposit itself. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
